test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers originates in a spring at Verinag in the south-eastern part of Kashmir?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jhelum.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Jhelum river originates from a magnificent spring called “Chashma Verinag”.**
 
• The Jhelum (Vyeth in Kashmiri, Vetesta in Sanskrit, and Hydaspes in Greek) is the main waterway of the Kashmir valley.
 
• Jhelum rises from its chief source Verinag at the foothills of Pir Panjal ranges in Jammu a
